title: KeteObject
description: One object as its owner says it to the center's index (doctrine D-062, R1, R2, R15; ADR 0014): what finds it, cites it and rights it — its title, its state, its four axes, its named links, where it opens. Never its data: the rest is read at its owner, under the reader's rights. Said again, it replaces what was said; said with `gone`, it leaves the index.

id.description: Its identifier at its owner: stable, unique within its kind.

title.description: What a person reads in a list, a « # » chip, a search: « Mini-centrale · École de Tsévié », « T-0412 · Onduleur hors ligne ».

project_id.description: The project of the center it belongs to.

party_id.description: The third party of the center it concerns.

unit_id.description: The unit of the structure it belongs to — a service, an agency, a site.

person_id.description: The person who answers for it: an account's user id.

links.description: Its named links to other objects, by a relation its kind declares.

href.description: Where it opens, when its kind's pattern does not say it.

updated_at.description: When its owner last changed it: an older saying never replaces a newer one.

gone.description: True takes it out of the index: deleted or no longer said by its owner.
